title: Increase Font Size (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Increase Font Size applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Increase Font Size (BtnIncreaseFontSize) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Increase Font Size moves the selection up the size ladder
scenarios.expected: Increasing the probe text moves its font size above the 18pt default along PowerPoint's size ladder, leaving text and geometry unchanged.

scenarios.title: Increase Font Size moves Font.Size up the ladder in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Increase Font Size on a 20 pt text box increases Font.Size (the documented direction on PowerPoint size ladder; measured 20 -> 24), reports execution, leaves the text content unchanged, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
